run_demo_cameras: run the trifinger simulation demo with camera visualization and press q to exit
run_demo_cameras_with_save: run the trifinger camera demo with --save-dir to save images by pressing s
run_demo_cameras_with_config: run the trifinger camera demo with --config-dir to load custom camera calibration files
run_demo_cameras_trifingerone: run the trifinger camera demo with --robot trifingerone to use the trifingerone robot type
save_images_function: save camera images to a directory using save_images with a counter for naming
